claims.claim: Added explicit versioned non-operative intake APIs while preserving existing TASK parsing, Task shape, V1/V2 policies, return affinity and VP-02 validator behavior. No Runtime integration was added.

The intake requires independent exact TASK, candidate, source, contract and mapping pins and delegates coverage validation to existing VP-02 semantics, retaining complete obligations, conditions and provenance.

The bounded immutable typed result reports structural completeness, preserves source and pin identities, explicitly leaves authentication and proof validity unestablished, and grants no production or execution authority.
Closed schemas, independent pin checks, command-substitution guards and existing VP-02 validation reject malformed, stale, incompatible, ambiguous and condition-conflicting declarations.

Added synthetic deterministic regressions for valid declarations, normalized ordering, versions, missing pins, hostile substitutions, full condition distinctions and filesystem, Git, network, process, clock and proof-execution traps.
The L1 document defines exact inputs, outputs and caller trust obligations, remaining L1–L3 engineering, unknown VP-01 measurements and KA-01 NOT_ACTIVATED/G3/G6 boundaries.
The committed change contains only the five authorized paths and introduces no scheduler, lifecycle authority, persistent ledger, historical mutation or roadmap/downstream change.
